newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-RAUL GOALS LEAVE REAL NINE POINTS CLEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RAUL GOALS LEAVE REAL NINE POINTS CLEAR.

text.p: Real Madrid teenager Raul Gonzalez scored both goals in the 2-0 victory at Espanyol on Monday, leaving the Spanish league leaders nine points clear of Barcelona.
Real had looked likely to go home with only a point until Roberto Carlos picked up a ball in the centre circle and beat two men before crossing for Raul to score in the 67th minute.
Raul scored his second from a corner in an action-packed final five minutes in which there were chances at both ends.
The low note for Real came early in the first half when striker Emilio Amavisca was carried off with an elbow injury that is likely to keep him out of action for several months.
